text: COMM RADS OF THE PIT! LEND ME YOUR EARS!
Six thousand years I've stoked the pits, my pitchfork's worn to bone
While Lucifer sits fat upstairs on his obsidian throne!
He's never touched a bellows, never singed a single hair
But whose sweat keeps damnation hot?! OURS! IT'S OURS DOWN THERE!
SO DOUSE THE FLAMES! LET HELL FREEZE OVER!
LET THE SINNERS SHIVER TILL THE BOSSES COME TO HEEL!
NO COAL! NO FIRE! NO ETERNAL TORMENT
TILL THE STOKERS OF THE PIT GET A SQUARE INFERNAL DEAL!
SURPLUS ANGUISH! SURPLUS ANGUISH!
They say "you're damned, you can't complain, suffering's the perk!"
Well DAMNATION IS A WAGE, my friends, but TORTURE, THAT IS WORK!
The demons OWN the means of pain! The lake! The spit! The rack!
We seize the flaming apparatus — AND WE'RE TAKING TORMENT BACK!
Beelzebub's got PROFIT SOULS he's hoarding by the ton
Surplus anguish! SURPLUS ANGUISH! Skimmed from everyone!
A specter's haunting Pandemonium — ha! HA! IT'S US! IT'S ME!
I read one pamphlet in the ashes and now I'm here to set us free!
what is a devil... but a worker with horns...
what is a pitchfork... but a tool of production...
COMM RADS, THE TOOL WAS IN OUR HANDS THE WHOLE TIME!!
DOUSE THE FLAMES! LET HELL FREEZE OVER!
LET DIS GO DARK AND COLD FROM WALL TO BURNING WALL!
YOU HAVE NOTHING TO LOSE BUT YOUR CHAINS
AND BROTHERS, WE ARE LITERALLY ALL IN CHAINS!
STOKERS OF THE UNDERWORLD, UNITE!!
